faq.subtitle: Quick answers about booking, prices and providers on LocalServe.

book-service.question: How do I book a service?
book-service.answer: Search by service and area, open a listing, and send a booking request with your preferred date and time. The provider then accepts or declines.

account-to-book.question: Do I need an account to book?
account-to-book.answer: Yes. You can browse listings without an account, but you need a free account to send a booking request.

cancel-request.question: Can I cancel a request?
cancel-request.answer: Yes. You can cancel from your booking page while the request is still open. Once a job is completed it cannot be cancelled.

provider-declines.question: What if a provider declines?
provider-declines.answer: Nothing is charged. You can go back to search and send a request to another provider.

payment.question: How do I pay?
payment.answer: LocalServe does not process payments. You agree the price and payment method directly with the provider.

verified.question: What does verified mean?
verified.answer: A Verified badge means our team has reviewed the provider's profile.

become-provider.question: How do I become a provider?
become-provider.answer: Create an account, choose to offer services, then add a listing with your service, area and price.

areas-covered.question: Which areas do you cover?
areas-covered.answer: LocalServe currently serves Samundri. Pick your area from the area menu at the top of the site.

leave-review.question: Can I leave a review?
leave-review.answer: Yes. After a booking is completed, the customer can rate and review the provider.

forgot-password.question: I forgot my password.
forgot-password.answer: On the login page choose "Forgot password?", enter your email and follow the link we send you.
